caption: All five natural FoldBench proteins with MSA depth <10 (test split). Each dot is one of 100 single-sequence ESMFold2 predictions, converted to a full contact/non-contact map and folded by Helico; diamonds use the ground-truth oracle map. Every map has the same eligible-pair mask and three Helico diffusion samples, selected by ranking_score. Contact counts may vary. Rank 1 is highest confidence among 101 maps; ties are shown as rank intervals. Vertical spread separates dots and has no numerical meaning. The menu switches to pLDDT of the same selected structures. These 500 decoys represent five proteins, not 500 independent biological examples. The ranking-score axis has an explicitly marked break to retain one clash-penalized score (−99.41) without compressing the other points; hover reports the unmodified score.
